newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai rubber prices edge up as rains curb supply.
newsitem.headline: Thai rubber prices edge up as rains curb supply.

text.p: Thai rubber prices were mostly steady to firmer from last week as rains hampered tapping and supply tightened, trade souces said on Friday.
Heavy rains continued to hamper tapping in the rubber-growing south. Supply to the market dropped by almost 10 percent from last week.
Enquiries were reported from Japan and China but demand remained weak, they said.
"There was some buying, but more of enquiries from countries in the Far East," one trader said. "But prices seemed to be supported by tighter supplies."
Thai benchmark RSS3 for December shipment was quoted around $1.23-1.25 a kg FOB Bangkok against $1.22-1.24 a kg last week.
STR20 was quoted around $1.22 a kg. Latex price was steady at 95 cemts a kg FOB Bangkok.
